profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with the stated goal of eliminating setup time and making app creation accessible without coding experience. Its site presents tools for creating mobile and web apps, landing pages, and videos within a single project, alongside built-in services covering authentication, database management, hosting, and monitoring.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as an agentic coding tool. The current iteration, Agent 4, is described on the company's site as capable of taking a single prompt, elaborating requirements independently, and sequencing and executing build tasks in an optimal order. The site also notes an integration with Lakebase and Databricks Apps, which Replit characterizes as combining its platform with enterprise data and governance capabilities. A noted concern associated with Replit Agent in the site's product registry is source-code exposure.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are included in the available data for Replit.
